scoring_justification: Full DFT recompute in the verifier is infeasible; the primary check is structural ordering of formation energies and volume changes, with a fallback absolute-tolerance comparison to paper-reported gold values to catch gross errors.

schema.description: A single line containing the total energy in eV as a floating-point number.

outputs.description: Total energy of the relaxed perfect Ti3SiC2 supercell, used as a reference for formation energies and checked against a hidden reference value.

schema.description: A single line containing the total energy in eV as a floating-point number.

outputs.description: Total energy of an isolated hydrogen atom, used as a reference for formation energies and checked against a hidden reference value.

Formation energies and relaxed volume changes for the three interstitial sites. The checker evaluates the relative ordering of formation energies (I-SiC ≈ I-SiTi < I-Ti) and volume changes (I-SiC < I-SiTi < I-Ti).

output_contract.notes: The primary verification is structural: the correct energetic ordering of the three sites. Additional reference checks compare absolute total energies (perfect_cell_energy.txt, isolated_H_energy.txt) against hidden paper-derived values with generous tolerance to account for code/pseudopotential differences.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference value for perfect_cell_energy.txt (total energy of perfect Ti3SiC2 supercell)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Synthetic dummy value of -8000.0 eV, chosen as an order-of-magnitude estimate for a 24-atom supercell with norm-conserving pseudopotentials.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Approximate typical total energy from DFT; the hidden reference is not a paper-reported value because the paper only reports formation energies.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Used with a very wide tolerance (±5000 eV) so that any genuine DFT calculation passes; only gross errors (e.g., missing file or completely wrong units) are penalized.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference value for isolated_H_energy.txt (total energy of isolated H atom)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Synthetic dummy value of -12.3456 eV, a typical isolated-hydrogen total energy with a norm-conserving pseudopotential.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Approximate value; the paper did not report E(H) explicitly.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Used with a wide tolerance (±10 eV) so that any physically meaningful H energy passes; penalizes only pathological values (e.g., positive or missing).

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference formation energies and volume changes for absolute tolerance check
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 1 of the paper: E_H^f (eV): I-Ti = -2.228, I-SiTi = -2.850, I-SiC = -2.853; ΔV (%): I-Ti = 1.45, I-SiTi = 0.90, I-SiC = 0.55.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the published paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported numeric results; they are used as a loose absolute check (tolerance ±1.0 eV, ±1.0%) to catch results that are far from the paper's values.

steps.description: Check that the perfect supercell total energy is within a generous order-of-magnitude tolerance.
Check that the isolated H atom total energy is within a generous tolerance.
Verify that the formation energy ordering is I-SiC ≈ I-SiTi < I-Ti and volume change ordering is I-SiC < I-SiTi < I-Ti.
Check absolute formation energies and volume changes against paper gold with loose tolerances (±1.0 eV, ±1.0%) to catch gross deviations.
